en: A monochrome winter scene showing a historic European town covered in snow, with a frozen or icy river in the foreground. A multi‑arch stone bridge crosses the river toward a large hilltop complex of Gothic towers and steep‑roofed buildings dominating the right side, likely a castle and cathedral. Snow blankets the roofs and the riverbank. At the bottom left margin in cursive script is the caption "Meissen im Winter."
